name: Skills page and the agent's Skills tab render the seeded skill
description: Loads /skills and confirms the seeded test-quality-rubric card renders, opens its preview drawer, then opens the Test Quality Reviewer agent and switches to its Skills tab to confirm the linked skill is listed. Exercises the /skills route and its fetch, the sidebar nav registration, and — the step with real regression value — the ?tab=skills entry in the agent editor's VALID_TABS, which falls back to Config SILENTLY when missing. The 'Skills' tab is matched by role=button because the sidebar's 'Skills' nav item is a link. Read-only seeded data (no model call). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml; run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
